fibonacci :: Int -> Int
fibonacci n
  | n < 2     = n
  | otherwise = fibonacci (n - 1) + fibonacci (n - 2)

quicksort :: Ord a => [a] -> [a]
quicksort []     = []
quicksort (x:xs) =
  let smaller = quicksort [y | y <- xs, y < x]
      larger  = quicksort [y | y <- xs, y >= x]
  in smaller ++ [x] ++ larger
